# FIXTURE: bad-03 — verse ends with כִּי (subordinator-cross-verse)
# Violation: causal/conditional כִּי at verse end; clause continues in next verse
# Rule: H10/cross-verse, pattern: subordinator-cross-verse, STRONG-MERGE-CANDIDATE
# Expected: ≥1 finding

1:1
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כִּי

1:2
בָּרַח הוּא מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה׃
